---
title: "The card"
subtitle: "One JSON document per store, read from metadata alone"
---

A card is built from a URL by reading metadata documents and, for 1-D and 2-D
coordinates, a sample of their values. It never reads a data chunk. Plain
Zarr, kerchunk references (JSON or Parquet) and Icechunk repositories give
the same card for the same metadata; a codec the environment cannot load is
recorded, not needed. Draft v0
sections:

| Section | Fields |
| ------- | ------ |
| `source` | url, form (zarr v2/v3, kerchunk json, kerchunk parquet, icechunk; mdim VRT and COG planned), Icechunk branch, snapshot and virtual chunk containers, metadata digest, scanned_at, assertions applied |
| `arrays` | name, dtype, shape, dimension names, chunk shape (inner and shard), codec chain |
| `values` | units, CF packing (`scale_factor`, `add_offset`), fill values from every source (Zarr `fill_value`, CF `_FillValue`, `missing_value`, STAC `nodata`) and whether they agree, `valid_range`, flag values |
| `grid` | declared form (`transform`, `coords_1d_regular`, `coords_1d_irregular`, `coords_2d`, `coords_named_missing`, `none`); axis order and direction; registration; the presented costume |
| `crs` | declared CRS (proj convention, CF grid mapping, WKT), and how it was found |
| `coord_sample` | for 1-D and 2-D coordinates: edges plus a central cross, enough for grid inference without re-reading the arrays |
| `cost` | non-spatial read factor for the inner chunk and the shard; tile amplification aligned and worst case |
| `hosts` | each host serving bytes: the metadata host, and for virtual stores each host the chunk references point at (from a sample of the index), with CORS status, range support, protocol and how it was probed |
| `findings` | ordered list of problems, each with a code from the table below |

```sh
storecard https://projects.pawsey.org.au/aad-derived/portolan-fixtures/stores/f03d-asi-latlon2d.zarr \
  --stac https://projects.pawsey.org.au/aad-derived/portolan-fixtures/catalog/f03/f03d-asi-latlon2d/collection.json
```

There is no formal JSON Schema for the card yet; the fixture tests in
`tests/` are its contract for now.
